requirement_contract.utf8:
# Requirement Contract

- Goal: Repair the accepted-task/host-turn terminal regression found by the final audit, revalidate the entire R4 change set, create one reviewable local commit, then publish the current branch to the configured GitLab and GitHub Git remotes.
- Users: Maintainers of the Agent Workflow Template and projects installed from it.
- Success: A real host turn accounted after complete-task preserves a durable, verifiable completion origin; route-resume remains terminal; adversarial and lifecycle regressions pass; manifests and fresh-state are current; the final commit is identical on both configured remotes.
- In scope: Context checkpoint completion-origin preservation, terminal validation, focused regression tests, managed manifests/fresh-state, full local audit and test suites, local commit, and branch pushes to remotes `origin` and `github`.
- Out of scope: Application deployment, production/test environment mutation, force-push, history rewriting, secrets changes, tag creation, merge requests, and branch merging.
- Constraints: Preserve existing user changes; never forge provider, human, scheduler, or platform evidence; use non-force Git pushes only; stop before pushing if any validation fails or either remote has incompatible history.
- Data and permissions: The user explicitly requested publication to the already configured GitLab and GitHub remotes; use only repository credentials already available to Git and do not expose credential material.
- Target environment: local
- Context transport: native
- Acceptance: Reproduce the post-completion account-turn regression before the fix; prove route-resume remains terminal after one and repeated-id host-turn accounting; run focused self-tests, default 29-run suite, full three-context suite when source changes are final, freshness/install/bootstrap/runtime checks, and verify both remote branch tips equal the local commit.
- Provenance: user request: R5 修复终态后 host-turn 计费并完成双远端发布核查
- Production provider target: none
- Human decisions: user:再次仔细检查所有的最新的修复还有没有问题，没问题直接推送到gitlab和github
- Clarified: true
